svg.aria-label: AC15 · board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from JMI drawing OA/031, "VOX AC.15 amplifier circuit No. 3" (29-4-60) — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; JMI published no board-layout sheet for the AC15 and none was located — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
